finding: Python Transformers 5.12.1 returns a BatchEncoding from apply_chat_template in the pinned serving environment. After extracting input_ids, all four frozen JavaScript-derived bindings match exactly in token count and token-ID SHA-256.
method: Installed transformers==5.12.1 in an isolated non-GPU virtual environment; loaded the exact model revision and three source files; reconstructed the exact append/prefix messages and tool schemas; rendered with add_generation_prompt=true; extracted BatchEncoding.input_ids; compared counts, per-request u32le token hashes, and common-prefix identities against the frozen binding.
root_cause: remote_baseline.py treated BatchEncoding as a list; len(BatchEncoding) was 1, causing the append count check to fail before token hashing
selected_fix: normalize apply_chat_template results by reading input_ids when the return value is mapping-like; do not change frozen tokenizer bindings
